summary: Frontend-only smoke test of the standalone prajeta-customer Expo app against the remote backend https://fleetride-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. App loads, / redirects to /login, and the customer login screen renders fully (header 'Log in or sign up', brand logo, name input, +91 mobile input, 'Send code on WhatsApp', 'Continue with Google'). Typing phone '123' and pressing send triggers client-side validation ('Enter your 10-digit mobile number'), so no OTP request goes out. Every API call observed goes to https://fleetride-hub.preview.emergentagent.com/api/... and responses come back: GET /api/public/config 200, GET /api/public/track/PRJ-TEST0000 404 shown in the UI as 'No booking found...', GET /api/tickets 401 when logged out. No CORS errors and no failed network requests. Customer-only: app/ contains only customer, booking, book, service, enquiry, track, support, ticket, live, page and notifications routes. /driver, /admin and /erp show 'Unmatched Route', and /customer while logged out redirects to /login. No data was created on the remote backend and /app/backend was not modified. No deprecated expo packages found.

integration_issues.issue: useQuery(['tickets']) in app/customer/support.tsx:20 is not gated on user. Logged-out users trigger 4 calls to GET /api/tickets that return 401 (react-query retries), with a spinner for about 7s before 'No tickets yet' appears. Gate it with enabled: !!user and/or skip retries on 401.

action_items: Optional/minor: in app/customer/support.tsx:20 add enabled: !!user to the tickets query (or retry: false on 401) to avoid repeated 401s and the long spinner on public /support
critical_code_review_comments: src/api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL with no hardcoded fallback. Good.
login.tsx: role-gating (APP_ROLES customer/corporate) signs out driver/staff accounts with a wrong-app message. Good.
authedUrl() puts the auth token in the query string (token=...), which can leak into logs/history. This is existing backend contract, FYI only.
seed_data_creation: None. Only read-only GETs plus client-side validation; no OTP sent and no enquiry submitted.
test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md missing (not needed for this smoke test)
